cases: 128 copies of each compatible partial view
Above the 4096 RPC-record bound within other decode bounds when possible
resources.memoryScope: Owned standalone Python worker. Windows process-lifetime PeakWorkingSetSize and optional Python allocation metrics; no browser memory or model memory claim.
expectations: Valid inputs retain exact report hashes across repeats
Over-bound input rejects or remains incomplete; it never produces a clean financial conclusion
Record cold/import and warm-assessment time separately; no universal speedup claim

fixtures: One deliberately inconsistent report, then success
One stale local anti-CSRF token, then controlled refresh
expected: Visible actionable error, no stale financial verdict/export
Retry on the same tab reaches an actual matching report
A token refresh is bounded to one retry
Four incomplete authorized loopback requests cannot leak assessment slots after their clients close

checks: Keyboard skip link, tabs/arrows, disclosures and modal dismissal
Focus returns visibly after transient failures and modal close
Rendered accessible names, result/error live semantics and busy controls
No document-level horizontal overflow; a labeled table may scroll within its own region
Contrast samples measured from rendered flat surfaces; this is not a full WCAG audit or screen-reader certification

policy: Review pinned official action.yml and README
Pin exact commits, disable unneeded credential persistence and automatic package-manager caching
Keep contents read-only; do not dispatch the fresh native/model workflow
Verify the ordinary four-job matrix on GitHub after publication

exclusions: No paid API, purchase, model call, wallet, signing, native transaction or message
No broad changes without a measured defect or requirement
scope: Same-author measured engineering review on owned local fixtures and published code; not an external audit.
